title: Mastrogiannopoulos and Anderson power Vikos Falcons to historic GBL promotion with Elite League Final Four triumph
description: Vikos Falcons made history on Sunday, becoming the first team from Ioannina â€” and the first from the Epirus region â€” to earn promotion to the Stoiximan Greek Basketball League (GBL), dismantling Evertech Papagou 87-72 in the Elite League Final Four championship game at the DAK Lefkadas. Sarandis Mastrogiannopoulos (194-PG-1997, agency: Octagon Europe) was the standout performer with 21 points, three rebounds, and eight assists in a commanding display, while Quincy Anderson (193-G-1999, college: Murray St.) matched him with 21 points and eight rebounds. The pair combined for 42 points as coach Thanasis Giaples's side took control early and never looked back.
